The remaining two patterns, tests/postgres/b4-*.ts and tests/postgres/b4-*.json, are the disposable-PostgreSQL harness; all four controls are static filesystem and source assertions requiring no database, so hosting them there would place DB-free controls behind a Docker-gated harness and make a mandated control silently unreachable wherever Docker is absent. tests/integration/** is explicitly prohibited by v1.0.0's placement_constraint.
